LLM cr"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"edentials never leave your machine."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Inspired by VS Code Remote-SSH, Zed, and JetBrains Gateway — **code and sessions live on the remote,"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" the local machine only renders the UI**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Supported environments"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Local (client)**: Windows / Linux / macOS. Node.js v20.19+ or v22+ and pnpm 11+ are only needed "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"for the **source-run** mode (pnpm is the default dev package manager, pinned via `packageManager`); "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"release packages bundle their own Node runtime.
- **Remote host**: Linux or macOS (POSIX); aarch64 ("},{"id":"p7s4","text":"arm64) and x86_64 both work. No Node preinstalled required — the tool installs and self-checks it.
-"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" **WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux)**: On Windows, WSL2 distributions are supported as remote targe"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ts. dsh is auto-installed inside WSL, tunneled via localhost forwarding — no SSH setup needed. Click"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" the "WSL Sessions" card in the panel to use; the entry is hidden on non-Windows platforms. The reve"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"rse channel — shared by the remote-window handoff and the LLM credential proxy — supports both WSL2 "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"networking modes (NAT binds the default-route gateway address alongside the loopback; mirrored rides"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" the shared loopback), with automatic networking-mode detection and a reverse-link self-check after "},{"id":"p7s11","text":"attach.
- **SSH authentication**: private key (`IdentityFile`, recommended); with no key configured,"},{"id":"p7s12","text":" an interactive terminal prompts for a password (no echo); `--password` also works (leaks via proces"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"s list / shell history — the CLI warns).
- Hosts come from `Host` entries in `~/.ssh/config`, or ad-"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"hoc `user@host[:port]` (IPv6 must go through the config)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation and running"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The CLI has two run modes (identical commands and options); if you already run dsh locally, you can "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"also install this tool as a **dsh plugin** (Option 3)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Option 1: run from source"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The repository has no build step; `.ts` source is executed directly via tsx. The dev environment def"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"aults to **pnpm** (version pinned via `packageManager` in package.json). After fetching the source:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Option 2: run a release package"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Download the archive for your platform from the release page (produced by the packaging script, name"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"d `dsh-remote-explorer-<version>-<platform>.<zip|tar.gz>`), unpack it, and run directly — no Node, n"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"pm, or network required on the target:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Platform | Archive | How to run after unpacking |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| win32-x64 | `.zip` | `dsh-remote-explorer.cmd <command>` |
| linux-x64 / linux-arm64 | `.tar.gz` |"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" `./dsh-remote-explorer <command>` |
| darwin-x64 / darwin-arm64 | `.tar.gz` | `./dsh-remote-explore"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"-explorer <command>` |
| darwin-x64 / darwin-arm64 | `.tar.gz` | `./dsh-remote-explorer <command>` |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Each package bundles the official Node binary (SHASUMS256-verified at download time) and a single-fi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"le CLI `dsh-remote-explorer.cjs` (all dependencies bundled in). Verify the archive against the sha25"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"6 published with the release."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Option 3: install as a dsh plugin"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"If you already run dsh (Web/Desktop) on this machine, install this tool into dsh and manage remote s"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"essions from a settings panel, a slash command, and agent tools:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> **Note for pnpm 11.7+ users (build-script approval gate):** pnpm 11.7 treats *undecided* dependenc"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"y build scripts as a hard failure, and this package's dependency tree carries three (`cpu-features`,"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" `esbuild` via tsx, `ssh2`) — the first `dsh plugin add` fails with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` regard"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"less of the install source. None of them are needed at plugin runtime: the artifacts are pre-built ("},{"id":"p21s5","text":"`lib/`, committed) and ssh2 falls back to pure JS. **Recommended:** install through the dsh web GUI'"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"s plugin manager page — it offers a built-in approve-and-retry flow. **CLI alternative:** after the "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"failed add, set the three pending `allowBuilds` entries to `false` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-work"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"space.yaml`, remove the half-committed `dsh-remote-explorer` entry from `dependencies` in `~/.dsh/pr"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"ofiles/web/package.json` (the failed add leaves it there, and a plain retry exits 0 without activati"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ng the plugin — a dsh CLI quirk present in 0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2), then re-run the add command."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` after installing. The plugin provides three surfaces:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **"Remote SSH Sessions" global panel in the left navigation**: pick a host, connect in two window "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"modes (enter current tab / open new tab), disconnect, live progress log; the advanced-options area c"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"arries three config dialogs (jump hosts — read-only for ssh-config aliases, editable for user@host d"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"irect hosts; environment variables; proxy), all remembered as your last global input and echoed in t"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"he per-connection log; the remote window carries a status pill for returning to the manager or closi"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ng/stopping the connection
- **Slash command** `/remote-explorer`: `hosts | connect <alias> [remote-"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"dir] | status | disconnect <alias|session-id> [--keep-remote]`
- **Agent tools** `remote_hosts_list "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"/ remote_connect / remote_status / remote_kill` (behind dsh's regular tool-approval gate)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Offline deployment"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"When neither the local nor the remote machine can reach the public internet, prepare resources on a "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"connected machine first, then deploy over the intranet SSH:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Compatible local DSH already installed**: install the plugin with the dedicated offline installe"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"r, import the remote runtime bundle, enable `offline: true` in the plugin config, and connect from t"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"he remote-sessions panel.
- **Standalone CLI**: use a platform package with bundled Node, import the"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" runtime bundle via `offline-import`, then connect with `connect --offline`; no local DSH required.
"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"- **No runtime on the remote host**: build a runtime bundle on an internet-connected machine of the "},{"id":"p27s6","text":"same OS and architecture with `offline-export`; offline connections never download missing dependenc"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"ies — versions follow the bundle manifest."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Editable source: docs/architecture/architecture.drawio (open in draw.io; CN/EN pages share the same "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"layout).
